phases.name: dependency_install
phases.command: npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

phases.name: playwright_e2e
phases.command: set -euo pipefail; npm run start -w @iam/backend >/tmp/runner-backend.log 2>&1 & backend_pid=$!; npm run dev -w @iam/frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/runner-frontend.log 2>&1 & frontend_pid=$!; cleanup() { kill "$backend_pid" "$frontend_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; wait_port() { for _ in $(seq 1 60); do (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/"$1") >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; sleep 0.5; done; echo "Timed out waiting for port $1" >&2; return 1; }; wait_port 3000; wait_port 5173; npm run test:e2e -- --workers=1
